function Source(x, uq, v, w, eta, mu, t)
  output_size(s) = 4;
  s[0] = 0.0;
  s[1] = 0.0;
  s[2] = 0.0;
  s[3] = 0.0;
end

function Tdfunc(x, uq, v, w, eta, mu, t)
  output_size(m) = 4;
  m[0] = 1.0;
  m[1] = 1.0;
  m[2] = 1.0;
  m[3] = 1.0;
end

function Ubou(x, uq, v, w, uhat, n, tau, eta, mu, t)
  output_size(ub) = 24;
  ub[0] = mu[4];
  ub[1] = mu[5];
  ub[2] = mu[6];
  ub[3] = mu[7];
  ub[4] = mu[4];
  ub[5] = mu[5];
  ub[6] = mu[6];
  ub[7] = mu[7];
  ub[8] = uq[0];
  ub[9] = 0.0;
  ub[10] = 0.0;
  ub[11] = (mu[8]*mu[10]*uq[0])/mu[9];
  ub[12] = uq[0];
  ub[13] = uq[1]-n[0]*(n[0]*uq[1]+n[1]*uq[2]);
  ub[14] = uq[2]-n[1]*(n[0]*uq[1]+n[1]*uq[2]);
  ub[15] = uq[3];
  ub[16] = mu[4];
  ub[17] = mu[5];
  ub[18] = mu[6];
  ub[19] = mu[7];
  ub[20] = uq[0];
  ub[21] = uq[1];
  ub[22] = uq[2];
  ub[23] = uq[3];
end

function Fbou(x, uq, v, w, uhat, n, tau, eta, mu, t)
  output_size(fb) = 24;

function FbouHdg(x, uq, v, w, uhat, n, tau, eta, mu, t)
  output_size(fb) = 16;
  fb[0] = uq[0]-uhat[0];
  fb[1] = -uhat[1];
  fb[2] = -uhat[2];
  fb[3] = -uhat[3]+(mu[8]*mu[10]*uhat[0])/mu[9];
  fb[4] = mu[4]-uhat[0];
  fb[5] = mu[5]-uhat[1];
  fb[6] = mu[6]-uhat[2];
  fb[7] = mu[7]-uhat[3];
  fb[8] = uq[0]-uhat[0];
  fb[9] = uq[1]-uhat[1];
  fb[10] = uq[2]-uhat[2];
  fb[11] = uq[3]-uhat[3];

function Initu(x, eta, mu)
  output_size(ui) = 4;
  ui[0] = mu[4];
  ui[1] = mu[5];
  ui[2] = mu[6];
  ui[3] = mu[7];
end

  output_size(s) = 7;
  s[0] = sqrt((uq[1]*uq[1])*1.0/pow((atan(uq[0]*1.0E+3-1.0E+1)/3.141592653589793+1.0/2.0)*(uq[0]-1.0/1.0E+2)+1.031830978008052E-2,2.0)+(uq[2]*uq[2])*1.0/pow((atan(uq[0]*1.0E+3-1.0E+1)/3.141592653589793+1.0/2.0)*(uq[0]-1.0/1.0E+2)+1.031830978008052E-2,2.0))*1.0/sqrt((mu[0]*((atan((uq[3]-(((uq[1]*uq[1])*1.0/pow((atan(uq[0]*1.0E+3-1.0E+1)/3.141592653589793+1.0/2.0)*(uq[0]-1.0/1.0E+2)+1.031830978008052E-2,2.0))/2.0+((uq[2]*uq[2])*1.0/pow((atan(uq[0]*1.0E+3-1.0E+1)/3.141592653589793+1.0/2.0)*(uq[0]-1.0/1.0E+2)+1.031830978008052E-2,2.0))/2.0)*((atan(uq[0]*1.0E+3-1.0E+1)/3.141592653589793+1.0/2.0)*(uq[0]-1.0/1.0E+2)+1.031830978008052E-2))*(mu[0]-1.0)*1.0E+3-1.0/1.0E+1)/3.141592653589793+1.0/2.0)*((uq[3]-(((uq[1]*uq[1])*1.0/pow((atan(uq[0]*1.0E+3-1.0E+1)/3.141592653589793+1.0/2.0)*(uq[0]-1.0/1.0E+2)+1.031830978008052E-2,2.0))/2.0+((uq[2]*uq[2])*1.0/pow((atan(uq[0]*1.0E+3-1.0E+1)/3.141592653589793+1.0/2.0)*(uq[0]-1.0/1.0E+2)+1.031830978008052E-2,2.0))/2.0)*((atan(uq[0]*1.0E+3-1.0E+1)/3.141592653589793+1.0/2.0)*(uq[0]-1.0/1.0E+2)+1.031830978008052E-2))*(mu[0]-1.0)-1.0E-4)+4.183097800805168E-4))/((atan(uq[0]*1.0E+3-1.0E+1)/3.141592653589793+1.0/2.0)*(uq[0]-1.0/1.0E+2)+1.031830978008052E-2));

  s[2] = mu[0]*(mu[3]*mu[3])*mu[9]*mu[15]*mu[18]*((atan((uq[3]-(((uq[1]*uq[1])*1.0/pow((atan(uq[0]*1.0E+3-1.0E+1)/3.141592653589793+1.0/2.0)*(uq[0]-1.0/1.0E+2)+1.031830978008052E-2,2.0))/2.0+((uq[2]*uq[2])*1.0/pow((atan(uq[0]*1.0E+3-1.0E+1)/3.141592653589793+1.0/2.0)*(uq[0]-1.0/1.0E+2)+1.031830978008052E-2,2.0))/2.0)*((atan(uq[0]*1.0E+3-1.0E+1)/3.141592653589793+1.0/2.0)*(uq[0]-1.0/1.0E+2)+1.031830978008052E-2))*(mu[0]-1.0)*1.0E+3-1.0/1.0E+1)/3.141592653589793+1.0/2.0)*((uq[3]-(((uq[1]*uq[1])*1.0/pow((atan(uq[0]*1.0E+3-1.0E+1)/3.141592653589793+1.0/2.0)*(uq[0]-1.0/1.0E+2)+1.031830978008052E-2,2.0))/2.0+((uq[2]*uq[2])*1.0/pow((atan(uq[0]*1.0E+3-1.0E+1)/3.141592653589793+1.0/2.0)*(uq[0]-1.0/1.0E+2)+1.031830978008052E-2,2.0))/2.0)*((atan(uq[0]*1.0E+3-1.0E+1)/3.141592653589793+1.0/2.0)*(uq[0]-1.0/1.0E+2)+1.031830978008052E-2))*(mu[0]-1.0)-1.0E-4)+4.183097800805168E-4);
